title: 第一卷 第7章 下一个目标！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
接下来的三天时间，姜无痕和林清雅几乎没出门。

    每天日日夜夜、日以继夜，为怀上双胞胎而努力耕耘。

    直到帝子殿的核心阵法传来波动，那是殿外有人求见的信号。

    姜无痕结束之后，这才穿上衣服，神清气爽的走出了帝子殿。

    一出门，姜无痕看到殿前跪着一群人。

    有曾经帝子殿的侍女和仆从，也有不少新面孔，少说得有上百人！

    这些应该都是姜临天为帝子殿新增的人手，专门伺候帝子和帝子妃的起居。

    这时，以雪姨为首，带着十几位圣人级别的护道者，各自端着一只托盘走了过来。

    “小无痕，家主说……你这几日辛苦了，特意命我等为你送来这十全大补汤！”

    “除此之外，这里还有大长老让我送来的‘破天丹’，说是……以备不时之需。”

    雪姨说着，递来一枚玉瓶。

    姜无痕看着这场面，忍不住嘴角抽搐。

    十全大补汤就算了，破天丹又是几个意思？

    这不是让那些不行的人，短暂成为真男人的虎狼之药吗？

    自己龙精虎猛，一夜一次，一次一夜，哪里需要这种东西？

    “十全大补汤放在殿内，这破天丹送还给大长老，让他自己留着用吧！”

    姜无痕摆手道。

    雪姨轻笑，微微点头。

    “对了，小无痕，这几天，家族帮你物色了不少人选，如今正在主殿议事。”雪姨开口，解释道，“家主说，你如果休息好了，就过去看一下……”

    “这么快就把阎浮大世界和下界的天之骄女筛了一遍？”姜无痕有些惊喜，忍不住笑道，“家主他们这效率，够快的！”

    如今，林清雅已经怀上。

    折腾了三天，也没有双胞胎的迹象，多半是够呛了！

    为了安全起见，在诞下孩子之前，最好还是不要再碰她了。

    纳妾之事，就要步入正轨！

    “走吧，雪姨，咱们现在就去！”

    姜无痕点头，走向主殿。

    雪姨望着姜无痕的背影，不由得感慨道：“小无痕明明刚成亲不久，时刻不忘辛勤耕耘。如今，为了家族，却又要继续纳妾。”

    “真是苦了这孩子了……”

    ……

    姜家主殿。

    姜临天和一众族老围坐在一条巨大的长桌旁，看着上方以灵力投影出的各方天之骄女画像，争论不休。

    “太凰仙朝的长公主，沐云溪，乃是仙心玉体，这是世之罕见的双修神体，与小无痕正好相配！”

    “老大，你安的什么心？沐云溪比小无痕大几十岁，连女儿都有了。难不成，你想让小无痕娶这个不守妇道的残花败柳？”

    “别把话说的这么难听，什么残花败柳？据我所知，沐云溪从来没有过男人。凝薇郡主是她十几年前收养的，并非亲女儿……”

    “那还不如娶沐凝薇，虽不是双修神体，却是有名的先天战体。在神体之中，排名极高！”

    “小孩子才做选择，全都要不好吗？”

    “太凰仙朝内部势力错综复杂，最好别让小无痕蹚这趟浑水。瑶池圣女，齐梦瑶，先天道胎。况且，我姜家曾与瑶池圣地有些渊源……”

    “还有太玄仙门的苏清玥，听说是剑仙转世，拥有清净琉璃剑心！”

    “这些个大势力，没一个是省油的灯，无痕名声在外，如今又刚成亲不久。你让他们把人嫁过来做妾，十有八九不会同意。”

    “格局打开，不是还有下界天骄吗？”

    就在众人争执之际，姜无痕到来。

    姜临天见状，连忙把他叫到身边，摁着他坐在了家主才有资格坐的上首宝座上。
content_en:
In the next three days, Jiang Wuhen and Lin Qingya hardly left the house.

    Every day, day and night, day and night, I worked hard to conceive twins.

    Until there was a fluctuation in the core formation of the Emperor's Palace, it was a signal that someone outside the palace was asking to see him.

    After Jiang Wuhen finished, he put on his clothes and walked out of the Emperor's Palace refreshed.

    As soon as he went out, Jiang Wuhen saw a group of people kneeling in front of the hall.

    There were maids and servants from the former Emperor's Palace, as well as many new faces, at least hundreds of them!

    These should be Jiang Lintian's new manpower for the Emperor's Palace, dedicated to taking care of the daily life of the Emperor and the Emperor's concubines.

    At this time, headed by Aunt Xue, there were more than a dozen saint-level protectors, each carrying a tray and walking over.

    "Xiao Wuhen, the head of the family said... you have worked hard these past few days and specially ordered us to deliver this Shiquan Dabu Decoction to you!"

    "Besides this, there is also the 'Heaven-Breaking Pill' that the Great Elder asked me to send...in case of emergency."

    Aunt Xue said and handed over a jade bottle.

    Jiang Wuhen couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth as he watched this scene.

    Forget Shiquan Dabu Decoction, what does Potian Dan mean?

    Isn't this the best way to make those who can't do it become real men for a short time?

    I am so powerful, one night at a time, one night at a time, why do I need this kind of thing?

    "The Shiquan Dabu Decoction is placed in the palace. This Heaven-Breaking Pill should be returned to the Great Elder and let him keep it for himself!"

    Jiang Wuhen waved his hand.

    Aunt Xue chuckled and nodded slightly.

    "By the way, Xiao Wuhen, the family has helped you identify many candidates in the past few days, and we are currently discussing matters in the main hall." Aunt Xue explained, "The head of the family said that if you have rested well, you can go over and have a look..."

    "How quickly did you screen out the most beautiful women in the world of Yanfu and the lower world?" Jiang Wuhen was a little surprised and couldn't help but laugh, "The efficiency of the family master and the others is quite fast!"

    Now, Lin Qingya is pregnant.

    After three days of tossing, there is no sign of the twins, which is probably enough!

    For safety reasons, it is best not to touch her again until the baby is born.

    The matter of concubinage must be put on the right track!

    "Let's go, Aunt Xue, let's go now!"

    Jiang Wuhen nodded and walked towards the main hall.

    Looking at Jiang Wuhen's back, Aunt Xue couldn't help but sigh: "Xiao Wuhen has just gotten married, and he never forgets his hard work. Now, for the sake of the family, he has to continue to take concubines."

    "It's really hard on this child..."

    …

    The main hall of the Jiang family.

    Jiang Lintian and a group of clan elders sat around a huge long table, looking at the portraits of proud girls from all over the world projected with spiritual power above, and arguing endlessly.

    "The eldest princess of the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, Mu Yunxi, has an Immortal Heart Jade Body. This is a rare dual-cultivation divine body in the world, and it is a perfect match for Xiao Wuhen!"

    "Boss, what are you worried about? Mu Yunxi is dozens of years older than Xiao Wuhen, and he even has a daughter. Is it possible that you want Xiao Wuhen to marry this unruly woman?"

    "Don't put it in such a harsh way. What's the matter? As far as I know, Mu Yunxi has never had a man. Princess Ningwei was adopted by her more than ten years ago, and she is not her biological daughter..."

    "Then it is better to marry Mu Ningwei. Although she is not a dual-cultivation divine body, she is a famous innate combat body. Among the divine bodies, she ranks extremely high!"

    "Children make choices, isn't it bad to do everything?"

    "The internal forces within the Taihuang Immortal Dynasty are complex. It is best not to let Xiao Wuhen wade through this muddy water. The Saint of Yaochi, Qi Mengyao, is an innate Taoist fetus. Besides, my Jiang family has some connections with the Yaochi Holy Land..."

    "There is also Su Qingyue from the Taixuan Immortal Sect. I heard that he is the reincarnation of the Sword Immortal and has a pure glazed sword heart!"

    "None of these big forces are economical. Wuhen has a good reputation, and they have just gotten married. If you ask them to marry someone as a concubine, they will most likely not agree."

    "When the situation opens up, aren't there still geniuses from the lower world?"

    Just as everyone was arguing, Jiang Wuhen arrived.

    When Jiang Lintian saw this, he quickly called him to his side and pushed him to sit on the throne that only the head of the family was qualified to sit on.
